SELECT dt.d_year , item.i_brand_id AS brand_id , item.i_brand AS brand , SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg 
FROM 
  (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id = 816) AS item 
  JOIN store_sales ON item.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk 
  JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 11) AS dt ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk 
GROUP BY dt.d_year , item.i_brand , item.i_brand_id 
ORDER BY dt.d_year , sum_agg DESC , brand_id 
LIMIT 100
